run_scale_ls: run scale_ls to compute a least-squares optimal scale factor between prediction and ground truth tensors
create_scaled_prediction: create a scaled prediction tensor from predictions and ground truth using least-squares scaling
test_scale_ls_clamping: test scale_ls to verify the scale factor is clamped between scale_min and scale_max
review_scale_ls_masking: review scale_ls to understand how optional masks are applied to predictions and ground truth
summarize_scale_ls: summarize scale_ls which returns a scaled prediction tensor and its detached scale factor
